title: Append-only prefix with generation rotation: an LSM-tree drift guard for cached prompt regions
idea: Log-structured merge trees and append-only logs never mutate written data in place; new state is appended and the old immutable segment stays valid until a deliberate compaction rotates a new generation. Apply this to the cached prompt prefix: treat each agent's stable-prefix region as immutable, forbid in-place edits that silently bust the cache mid-fleet, and require any real change to bump an explicit prefix-generation marker (a deliberate compaction). A CI lint guards that no PR mutates a cached-prefix region without rotating its generation, turning invisible cache-busting drift into a reviewable, versioned event — the same discipline this repo already applies to release-surface drift.
basis: Source domain = storage systems. Log-structured merge trees / append-only logs (LevelDB/RocksDB, log-structured file systems) achieve stable-read performance by never mutating in place and rotating generations via explicit compaction. Anthropic prompt caching invalidates the entire suffix on any prefix byte change, so immutable-prefix + generation-rotation is the direct structural remedy for silent cache-busting drift.
